Commentary.Commentary: South Africa's innings was all about partnerships. In spite of losing wickets, they always had the upper hand due to that. Sri Lanka have a big task ahead now. Their batting has been below-par in this series so far and they have to bat out of their skin to overhaul this target. What will happen in the chase? Do join us in a short while to find out.

Sri Lanka's bowling was pretty much substandard. Apart from a quiet period when Faf du Plessis was dismissed, they never managed to gain the upper hand. The runs continued to flow and there was no pressure applied by the Lankan bowlers. Kamindu Mendis, the ambidextrous debutant, was the most economical bowler whereas Isuru Udana with a couple of wickets was the most successful one in terms of wickets taken.

It all started with Sri Lanka putting South Africa to bat after winning the toss. Reeza Hendricks was dismissed cheaply but once again the touring team encountered the pair of de Kock and du Plessis in sublime form. The duo raised a 97-run stand in quick time and punished the Lankan bowlers to all parts of the park. The South African skipper lost his wicket soon after the first Drinks interval but in came yet another handy partnership for the Proteas. Quinton de Kock broke his deadlock by stroking a fluent century after 17 innings while Rassie van der Dussen continued with his amazing form to notch up one more score of a fifty.

Outstanding cameo from Andile Phehlukwayo towards the end as South Africa amassed 53 runs in the last four to take their total past the 325-run mark. We witnessed some power hitting in the death overs and Sri Lanka looked clueless against the onslaught. This is now South Africa's highest score batting first in Durban in ODIs.

FOUR! Ends the innings with a boundary. A slower one, landing full outside off, Phehlukwayo shuffles across the stumps and then goes for a big heave across the line. He loses his balance but still manages to clear short fine leg. South Africa end on 331/5!
Short and pulled in front of square leg for a couple of runs. Good running between the wickets.
FOUR! Smashed away! Width on offer outside off, Andile camps back and spanks it through point for a boundary.

What was that? Funny, really funny. No calling whatsoever between the two fielders. Slower one by Malinga, full and around leg, Phehlukwayo tries to heave it over the leg side but ends up towering it in the air towards square leg. Kasun Rajitha from inside the ring and Akila Dananjaya from outside go for it, no one called and the ball dropped right in between them. A couple is taken and Malinga ain't impressed.
Another slower one, a touch short on leg, Phehlukwayo plays it down to point and crosses. The fielder has a needless shy at the striker's end and concedes an extra run.
Good length ball on middle, at 114 kph, Miller punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Fullish and outside off, drilled down to extra cover for a couple of runs. 14 from the over, the local boys are doing it for South Africa.
FOUR! Streaky again from Andile. Fullish and wide outside off, Phehlukwayo tries to squeeze it out but it catches the outside edge and screams away to the third man fence.
SIX! This one has travelled the distance! Quicker one by Isuru Udana. He bangs in a short ball and Phehlukwayo pulls it thunderously over mid-wicket.
DROPPED BY OSHADA! A slower short ball outside off, Miller heaves it over mid-wicket and Oshada near the fence drops a sitter. They take a single.
Angles in a full ball on off, Andile forces it down to long on and hands the strike to Miller.
Full and on off, Phehlukwayo blazes his cover drive but fails to beat the fielder inside the ring. He looks for a run but is sent back.

Another off pace delivery, on a length around middle, Miller flicks it with soft hands through square leg and scampers across for the second run. A better throw at the bowler's end would have had Phehlukwayo. 13 from the over, two more to go.
300 up for South Africa! Back of a length delivery around leg, Phehlukwayo stands back and turns it in front of square leg for one.
Keeps it nice and straight, slower in pace at 117 kph, David taps it down to covers and crosses for a run.
Too full and on middle, Phehlukwayo bunts it down to mid off and steals a single. 10 off 4 balls from Andile.

EDGY FOUR! Unlucky for the bowler. Malinga has deceived the batsman there with his slower ball. It's short and outside off, Andile pushes inside the line and edges it wide of the keeper and short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Good start to the over. A slower delivery but there is width on offer outside off, Phehlukwayo plays a superb square drive to fetch a boundary.

FOUR! That's brilliant! Udana lands it too full and in the hitting zone for the batsman. Miller bludgeons it through extra cover and there is no chance for the deep fielder to cut it off. 11 runs and a wicket from the over.
Too full and wide outside off, Andile drives it through point for a run.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the new batsman.

OUT! The leg stump goes for a walk. A terrific back of the hand slower delivery, a cutter landing around leg has done the job. Dwaine Pretorius is down on his knees in an attempt to sweep it across the line. But the slowness of the delivery foxes him completely. Dwaine is too early through the swing of his bat and it arrives late. The ball sneaks past his pads and uproots the leg stump. End of a handy knock by DP!
Slower length ball outside off, Miller steers it through point for a run.
Third man and fine leg are up.
Fullish and on off, driven down to long off for one.
FOUR! Shot! Not the ideal start to the over. Udana delivers a full toss outside off, Pretorius reaches out for it and rifles his drive behind point for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up!
Isuru Udana is back on.
Slower one again beats the batsman. Miller stays back to play the back foot punch but is way too early. Excellent over at this stage, just 4 from it.
On one bounce to the fielder! A slower full ball on off, Dwaine slogs it over mid-wicket and Kamindu in the deep picks it late. Gathers the ball on one bounce and they take another run.
This one is in the line of the stumps, another slower one at 117 kph, Miller strokes it off his front foot to long off. They pick up a single.
Foxes Miller with a slower one. Malinga takes the pace off this one and serves it on a length outside off. David is ages early into his shot and hence misses.
Too full in length on off at 134 kph, Pretorius squeezes it out to cover-point and crosses.
Slower one, on a fuller length around off, David drives it to long off for a single.
Change of ends for Lasith Malinga.
Full and on the pads, Miller clips it in front of square leg and retains strike with a single.
Fullish on off, driven to covers.
Forces a full ball down to long on and crosses for a run.
Wide! Quicker one down the leg side, Dwaine leaves it.
SIX! Clean hitting! Full and floated landing on off, Pretorius has this right in the slot. Latches onto it and powers it inside-out over extra cover for a biggie.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Goes on the back foot and smashes it down to long off for a run.
Some drops of rain visible. Akila Dananjaya is back into the attack to bowl under gloomy conditions.
Another full toss on middle, it's forced down to long off for one. Tidy over by Isuru, just 6 from it.
Full toss outside off, a well-timed cover drive for a run.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
A clever short ball, slower in pace, Pretorius hits it down past his partner for a run at long off.
Pace is up this time and it's full on middle, Miller knocks it down to long on and takes a single.
Beaten all ends up! A slower one first up, on a length outside off, Miller is sucked into a drive but is beaten due to the slowness of the ball.
Isuru Udana is back into the attack.
A little short in length on off, Miller goes on his toes and dabs it to third man for a single.
Straighter in line, Miller sticks back and taps it down to point.
A slower one, on a length, Dwaine taps it down to mid-wicket and pinches a quick single.
Digs out a yorker to mid on, looks for a run but then sends Miller back.
Full this time, on leg, Miller flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short in length on middle, pulled in front of square leg for a run.
Too full in length on off, driven firmly to covers where the fielder fumbled and allowed a run. 10-0-45-1, a decent outing for the debutant.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it to fine leg for a couple. Given as leg byes.
Works this one with the spin through mid-wicket and rotates the strike. 250 up for South Africa.
Arm ball on middle, skidding in, Pretorius moves deep inside the crease and punches it to long on for a run.
Quicker and fuller on off, Miller drives it down with a straight bat to long off for a single.
FOUR! Miller power! Tossed up delivery landing full outside off, David skips down the track and crunches it over extra cover for a boundary.
Hits the yorker length outside off, Dwaine tries to dig it out but fails to do so. A 11-run over comes to an end.
FOUR! Shot! Malinga eyes a yorker but instead bowls a juicy half-volley on off, Pretorius drills his drive through extra cover for a boundary.
Quicker delivery. A low full toss on leg, Pretorius fails to flick and it goes behind towards fine leg off his pads. They take a couple of leg byes.
Bunts a full ball down to mid off and steals a quick single.

NOT OUT! A yorker on off, Dwaine digs it out to point and Miller wants a run. He wears his skates and rushes to the other end as the point fielder runs ahead and dives forward to score a direct hit. It's referred upstairs but Miller is well in.
Shout for a run out. The square leg umpire has gone upstairs...
Digs in a short ball on off, Dwaine pulls it behind square leg and gets a couple of runs.
Wide! Wrong start from the skipper. Slips a full ball down the leg side, Pretorius tries to flick but misses.
Powerplay 3 time! A maximum of 5 fielders are allowed outside the ring now. Lasith Malinga is back on as well.
Similar delivery, but Pretorius drives it to the right of extra cover. Long off gathers the ball running to his left, single taken.
Bowls it full on off, driven towards the extra cover fielder.
Around off, Pretorius punches it to covers.
Tosses it outside leg and full, Dwaine pushes it back to the bowler.
Dwaine Pretorius is the next batsman in.

OUT! Kamindu Mendis gets his maiden wicket, albeit through a poor delivery. A long hop on middle, there to be hit. Van der Dussen kneels to pull it across the line but fails to connect. He is hit on the box, they appeal and the finger has gone up. David Miller suggests him to take the DRS and Rassie obliges. The replays roll in and they show that it's hitting the middle stump. That's the end of van der Dussen and the 44-run stand.
Shout for an lbw. It's given. A late call by Rassie to review it. Let's see...
Lands it a bit short and on middle, it's punched off to mid on for a single.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to long on for a run. 6 from it!

Fifty for Rassie van der Dussen, his 4th in ODIs! What a start to his career. Showing great maturity in terms of his composure. Floated full ball on off, Rassie drives it down through mid off and takes a run.
Again very full to the left-hander, around off, Miller drives it down through mid off for a single.
Loopy and full on middle, turning away slightly, van der Dussen quietly pushes it to covers and rotates the strike.
Very full and on middle, it's been driven through covers for a run.
Lunges to a full ball and pushes it gently to point for a run.
Comes from round the wicket this time. The ball was angling in, it's pulled towards the mid wicket fielder.
Punched to the right of point by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flighted on off, defended off the front foot towards the bowler.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short and around the stumps, van der Dussen gets on the top of the delivery and pulls it hard through the mid-wicket region.
Floated fullish on middle, Rassie charges out and blocks it out to the off side for a run.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Quicker again, full and on leg, Rassie helps it to square leg and rushes across to the other end.
Fires one on middle and leg, it's tucked through square leg for a run.
Gets away with that, Akila! Short and way wide outside off, Miller chases and hits it off the toe end to covers. Would have been a wide had he left it.
Flatter and on middle, skidding on, Miller goes back and pushes it to the bowler.
Floated full ball on leg, Miller softly plays it off his pads to the leg side.
Flighted and on off, reverse swept to short third man for a run.
Akila Dananjaya is back on.
Shorter this time, pulled by the batsman to the deep square leg region for a run.
Flighted ball played on the off side. Miller wanted to take a run but Rassie shouts a NO loudly. Good call by the striker.
Tossed up outside off, played towards the cover region for a single.
Floated outside off, Rassie pushes it to mid on again and manages to pick a single this time.
Tossed up around off, van der Dussen punches it to mid on.
FOUR! Rassie plays a late-cut through the vacant slip position as the ball runs down for a boundary. A good chase offered by the short third man fielder but in vain.
Fullish and on off, Miller drives it off his front foot but straight to mid off.
The line is straight and Miller times his flick shot nicely through mid-wicket. A couple taken.
Short and wide outside off, Rassie mistimes his back foot punch to covers and rushes to the other end. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end otherwise it could have been tight.
Sliding down the leg side, Miller fails to get it away and it goes off his thigh pad to square leg. A leg bye is taken.

FOUR! Magnificent shot! This will give Miller a lot of confidence. An overpitched ball outside off, David cracks it off his front foot and the mid off fielder is a bit lazy in diving across to his right.
Good length ball on off, Rassie gets back and guides it to third man for a run.
Floated delivery on the off stump line, driven straight to long off and they take a run.
Switches arm and lands it outside off with his right, Miller strokes it to covers and takes a single.
The batsman plays a square cut to the point region and gets a single.
Floated outside off, Rassie plays it back to the bowler.
Darted in outside off, pushed to covers for a run.
Full ball, punched towards the cover region for a quick single.
Good length and line, Miller offers his respect and shoulders arms to the delivery.
Pitches outside leg and angles it on the pads, Miller looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pad. An appeal from the bowler but turned down by the umpire. Too high.
Short and near the waist, Miller punches it off the back foot to the fielder at cover.
Angled outside off, Miller tries to drive but misses. The ball goes past the outside edge and straight to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, Rassie taps it one bounce over the cover fielder for the sweeper cover to fetch. The batsmen take a single.
Half-volley around off, Rassie drives it to mid off.

Drinks break. South Africa are in a strong position here in spite of losing Quinton de Kock. The wicketkeeper-batsman scored a magnificent century and has set a good launching pad. Sri Lanka continue to struggle in the field. The way they are bowling, they will be chasing anything close to 350. Can they force a collapse like the last ODI?
Back of a length this time, Rassie forces it off the back foot towards long on.
Slightly fuller in length, driven towards the cover fielder and Miller is off the mark with a single.
Floated on off, Miller defends it off the front foot.
Short and outside off, van der Dussen cuts it to deep cover and picks a single this time.
Rassie smashes it to deep cover and comes back for the second.
Tossed up on off, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler.
David Miller is the new batsman.

OUT! Rajitha gets the wicket of the danger man after going for 15 runs in the over. He angles across a length ball just around off, de Kock gets carried away here. Strides down the track, looking for yet another big shot but gets a faint outside edge to the keeper. Dickwella catches it and tosses it up in celebration. A disappointed-looking Quinton is walking back. The umpire quickly checks for the front foot no ball as well but all is fine. End of a magnificent knock by Quinton but he definitely will be feeling that he missed out on a chance to score a double century.
Outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.

FOUR! Blazed away! Slower short ball outside off, once again de Kock picks it early and absolutely blazes it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Rajitha running out of ideas. Two more balls to go in this over...
FOUR! Pulled away sweetly. Back of a length on leg, Quinton pulls it to square leg and the ball rushes to the ropes for a boundary.
A length ball outside off, de Kock drives it over extra cover and it slows down in the deep. They take a couple.
Wide. Bowls a yorker this time, but it's way outside off even outside the tramline. Wide signalled by the umpire.
FOUR! Quick and fuller outside off, de Kock plays a lofted straight drive over the bowler's head. It races away to the fence, no stopping those.
Short and wide outside off, cut off the back foot but straight to the fielder at covers.
Flatter one, full and on off, defended close to the body.
Tossed up ball wide outside off, van der Dussen stretches forward and then makes a leave.
FOUR! First real bad delivery bowled by the debutant. A rank long hop on middle, Rassie goes down immediately and pulls it powerfully through square leg. 50-run stand is up!
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, punched off the back foot but straight to cover-point.
Short and outside off, de Kock looks to play it but gets an edge and the ball runs down to mid off.
Around length, punched to mid off by the batsman for a single.
Continues bowling short, but this time Rassie pulls it off his front foot towards deep mid wicket for a single.
Drags the length back a bit and keeps it on off, Rassie looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto his shoes.
On length and on middle, van der Dussen defends it out.
Starts with a bouncer. Rassie ducks out of its way.
Change in bowling. Kasun Rajitha is back into the attack. Has been very expensive today.
Goes back and taps it down wide of mid on. 3-0-7-0, the debutant so far.

NOT OUT! De Kock is safely back inside the crease. Sensing the charge from the batsman, Kamindu bowls it short and wide outside off, Quinton tries to cut but misses and falls in the process. Dickwella breaks the stumps and appeals. It's referred upstairs but the replays show that de Kock has dragged his back leg inside the crease just in time.
Appeal for a stumping. It's referred upstairs. Not much excitement shown by Dickwella.
Loopy and on off, de Kock presses forward and blocks it to the off side.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Rassie gets back and turns it in the gap at square leg for one.
Uses his feet and hits it down to long on for a run.
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot.
This was a nice length ball angling away, beats the outside edge just by an inch. Rassie was doubtful whether to play at it or leave.
Shorter ball pulled towards mid wicket but no run scored.
Around off, punched back to the bowler.

Loud appeal...turned down by the umpire. Comes over the wicket and bowls on the leg. Quinton looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pad. Bowler appeals but the umpire is not impressed, maybe it is going over the stumps. The batsmen run through and it's given as a run. So, some inside edge.
Similar line and length but this time to the right-hander who clips it off his pads on the on side.
Short and width on offer, de Kock cuts it off his back foot towards point and takes a run.
Fullish on leg, the batsman has worked it away to the short fine leg fielder.
Flicked away to square leg by the batsman. The batsmen rotate the strike.
Fuller ball, defended off his front foot.
Changes the length and bowls it tad shorter, Rassie punches it off his back foot for a single towards extra cover.
Around off, Rassie plays it to point with soft hands.
Yorker on middle, Rassie digs it out to covers.
Fullish and on the pads, eased towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Beaten by the extra bounce. On a good length outside off, van der Dussen pushes inside the line and misses.
Good length ball angling down the leg side, Quinton helps it down to fine leg for one.
Short again, outside off, Rassie cuts it to point where the fielder makes a half-stop. Parries it to the cover fielder and they cross.
In the air... safe! Short ball on middle, de Kock top edges his attempted pull shot and it falls safely behind the bowler. A single taken.

FOUR! Finally a century for Quinton de Kock, his 14th in ODIs. The last one came in October 2017. After that there were 17 innings in which he batted, scoring 50-plus on six occasions. The drought is over for Quinny. A touch short in length and outside off, de Kock camps back and runs it down to third man for a boundary. Raises his bat and enjoys the ovation from the crowd. Fine knock by the wicketkeeper batsman, he would like to make a big one here with plenty of overs left.
Left-arm off cutter to van der Dussen, who plays a forward defense to end the over.
Targets the pads, flicked away by the batsman to the leg side.
Lands it outside off, slices it to covers and picks up a single.
Switches to right hand for the southpaw. Bowls it outside off, Quinton runs it down to point.
Bowls it with his left hand to Rassie who clips it behind square leg for a single.
Starts off his over with a full ball onto the pads, de Kock plays it on the on side for a run.
Here comes the debutant. Kamindu Mendis, the ambidextrous spinner, is into the attack.
Outside off, driven by Quinton to the mid off fielder to fetch. The batsmen rotate the strike.
Length ball around off, de Kock gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Short and outside off, de Kock plays it off his toes punching it to the extra cover fielder.
A full length ball outside off, Rassie plays it with soft hands and straightaway takes off for a quick single.
Targets the pads again, de Kock works it away to the square leg fielder to fetch a run while he reaches the other side of the crease.
Bowls it down the leg, flicked away to the backward square leg for a single.
Nice flight this time, full and dipping on off, van der Dussen drives it to mid off and scampers across to the other end.
Slow loopy full ball on leg, de Kock drives it down to long on for a single.
Shortish and on middle, punched down to long on for a run.
Serves it outside off, de Kock slices it to deep cover and reaches the non-striker's end.
Punched back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Around middle stump, Rassie turns it away to deep square leg and picks a single.
A touch short and on off, it's punched from the crease to sweeper cover for a run.
Digs in a short ball outside off, Rassie crouches a bit and then allows it through to the keeper.
Eases a full ball down through mid off and crosses to the other end. Moves to 91!
A length ball on middle and off, de Kock is on the back foot as he blocks it down safely.
FOUR! This is deja vu for Thisara. His line continues to be straight, on a length, de Kock brings his wrists into play and flicks it handsomely behind square leg for a boundary.

FOUR! No, not again! Perera has changed ends but it has started exactly the same way like his first over. Shortish and around leg, de Kock nudges it past the short fine leg fielder. A welcome boundary for South Africa.
Leg spinner this time straight on middle stump, Rassie digs it out at the last moment and plays it straight towards mid off.
Flighted delivery outside off, de Kock cuts it towards the gully region for a single.
Again a reverse sweep and again blocked by the short third man fielder. Frustrating for Quinton.
Lands it full on off, de Kock brings out the reverse sweep but hits it straight to the short third man fielder.
Floated on off, defended off the front foot.
Width on offer, Rassie drives towards the deep cover fielder and takes a run.

Excellent finish by Malinga. Length ball around off, gives no room to the batsman to play the shot. The batsman has pushed it back to the bowler. Just a run from the over, Sri Lanka have successfully managed to choke the flow of runs post the departure of Faf du Plessis.
In the channel, slightly fullish, on middle, de Kock hits it hard on the leg side but finds mid on.
Short ball near the waist, de Kock plays it gently on the on side.
Full ball outside off, driven towards the extra cover fielder.
Around off, Quinton punches it to the right of the bowler. It is swiftly collected by the mid off fielder.
Back of a length outside off, Rassie cuts it to point and gets to the non-striker's end.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated on leg, de Kock plays the reverse sweep towards the point region and takes a run.
Tossed up delivery on off, de Kock drives it towards the extra cover fielder.
Lands it around the leg, de Kock plays it against the spin towards mid-wicket.
Full toss on middle, Quinton punches it to the right of the bowler and Akila stops it with a dive.
Tossed up of off, Rassie steers it away to point for a single.
Akila Dananjaya is back on.
Full toss this time on his pads, van der Dussen plays it to the deep backward square leg fielder and goes for the run.
Length on his pads, de Kock clips it behind square leg for a single.
Bowls it on a length and directs it on the pads, van der Dussen has flicked it to mid-wicket and gets off the mark.
Starts with a short ball to the fresh batsman. Rassie ducks a bit to let it pass over the head.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new batsman.

OUT! A wicket immediately after the break. Malinga brought himself back into the attack and has managed to dismiss his counterpart. He delivers a short ball around middle and leg, du Plessis gets back to pull it across the line but it catches the top half of his bat and goes straight to Dickwella. They appeal and the finger goes up. End of a 97-run stand and du Plessis will be disappointed to miss out on a fifty.
On a length and on middle, Quinton tucks it away to square leg and picks a single.
Lasith Malinga is back on.

Drinks break. South Africa are cruising and not for the first time in this series, the Lankan bowlers are looking clueless. The current batting pair has been in red-hot form and once again they are looking on-song. The touring side needs a breakthrough quickly. We might just see the debutant and the highly-talked about spinner, Kamindu Mendis in action soon.
Length ball and width on offer, du Plessis plays it off the back foot towards the point fielder. Another 13-run over for South Africa.
Full ball just outside off, de Kock plays it towards mid off and goes for a quick run. Good call by the batsman.
Straighter line on his pads, de Kock defends it solidly. Some sanity back for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries. A slower delivery, short and outside off, de Kock stands tall and whacks it past the right side of mid off for a boundary. Thisara under immense pressure.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries from the wicket-keeper batsman. Again Perera bowls it on the leg, Quinton flicks it hard and this time past the right side of the short fine leg fielder. Toying with the fielder there.
FOUR! Poor line and punished by Quinton. Length on the pads, de Kock works it fine past the left side of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Thisara Perera to have a go now.
Flatter and quicker on middle, flicked straight to the fielder on the leg side. 13 from the over, South Africa are going strongly.
FOUR! Edgy! Floated delivery outside off, du Plessis attempts an inside-out shot over covers but ends up slicing it off a thick outside edge past first slip for a boundary.
Full length ball straight this time, de Kock drives it to long on and takes a run.
The batsman punches it to the mid on fielder for a single.
Tossed up outside off, de Kock pushes it to covers and gets to the non-striker's end.
SIX! Welcome shot right on the first ball of the over. Full on middle, Quinton hammers it over the long on fence for a maximum. 100 up for South Africa!
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Fuller ball on his pads, clips it through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Short ball this time, de Kock reads it early, goes for the pull and connects it well to get a boundary at deep backward square leg.

FOUR! CLASSY! 4th ODI half century for de Kock in a row, 21st overall. What a way to reach there. Half-volley around off, Quinton smashes it towards long off. Faf at the non-striker's end ducks down just in time to get out of the way.
Slightly fullish on the pads, du Plessis flicks it away to square leg bit uppishly as he reaches the non-striker end.
Length ball outside off, Quinton guides it to the sweeper cover. The batsmen rotates the strike.
Slower ball on the pads, de Kock plays it towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up this time, du Plessis plays it off the back foot on the on side for a run.
Floated on off, de Kock goes on his knees and plays the sweep towards deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up on leg, Faf turns it away to square leg and collects a single.
Works it on the leg side with the spin for a run.
SIX! High and handsome, first of the match! 50-run stand comes up! Tossed up ball landing on middle, de Kock steps down and hammers it over wide long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Deliberate edge! Short in length and outside off, du Plessis stays back and intentionally lofts it over first slip for a boundary.
Shortish and on middle, de Kock goes deep inside the crease and cuts it through backward point for a run.

Fine stop but then concedes an overthrow! Full ball outside off, de Kock drives through the extra cover area. Thisara Perera stops it with one hand, diving across from mid off and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. The batsmen scamper for another run.
Dark clouds are now hanging over the stadium.
Good line and length, de Kock punches it back to the bowler.
On a length, du Plessis looked to flick it away but gets a leading edge to it and the ball runs down to the cover uppishly. A run taken though.
FOUR! EDGED! Ahead of a length, outside off, Faf gets a thick edge through the vacant slip position as the ball runs down for a boundary.
Another bowling change. Kasun Rajitha gets a change of ends.
Fuller this time on the leg stump line, de Kock plays the sweep shot towards fine leg for a brace.
Flighted on off, de Kock plays it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, de Kock comes forward and defends it.
Lands it around the leg, de Kock charges out but then pushes it to the off side.
Tossed up on off, the batsman defends it on the back foot.
Flighted on off, de Kock pushes it to covers.
Spin time! Akila Dananjaya is into the attack. A slip for him.
Full toss on middle, du Plessis doesn't expect it and pushes it down to mid off. Straight to the fielder. A good start for South Africa in Powerplay 1.
Stays back to a length ball and helps it in front of square leg for a run.
Back of the hand slower delivery, on a fuller length outside off, de Kock is early into his drive and mistimes it to backward point.
FOUR! No stopping this one. The length is on the shorter side around off, de Kock picks it up very early, rocks back and pulls it with authority past the diving mid-wicket fielder.
Follows the batsman down the leg side with a fullish length ball, Quinton pushes it out to mid off.
Slower one, on a fuller length around middle, du Plessis softly pushes it in front of square leg and pinches a single. Good calling once again from de Kock.

FOUR! Connects and connects well this time. Rajitha digs in a short ball around leg, de Kock swivels on the back foot and nails his pull shot through square leg for a cracking boundary. 11 from the over, 28 in last 3. 50 up for South Africa as well.
Good length ball on middle, Quinton flicks it on the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, de Kock tries his best to pull it but fails to connect.
Gentle hands from Faf. He taps a length ball in the direction of third man. The wide first slip fielder puts in a dive but fails to stop it cleanly. De Kock calls his skipper for a run.
FOUR! Du Plessis is dealing in boundary. Receives a back of a length ball on off and he smashes it off his back foot to the sweeper cover fence.
Takes a stride forward to a length ball and whips it through mid-wicket. There is a sweeper in place on the leg side and hence only a run.
Lands it on a good length around off, de Kock stays on the back foot and blocks it down the surface.
Uses his wrists to a length ball and flicks it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Short and pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Goes on the back foot to a short ball and punches it to the off side.
FOUR! Uppish but safe! A wonderful shot from the South African skipper. On a length around middle, Faf brings down a straight bat and pushes it aerially down the ground for a boundary.
A length ball on off, angling away, du Plessis drives it on the up but finds the mid off fielder.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Outside off, left alone by the batsman. 10 from the over, an expensive start from Kasun.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Faf defends it from the crease.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it down to mid on.

FOUR! An overpitched ball on off, du Plessis forces his off drive down the ground and Kusal Perera puts in a dive again. It brushes his fingers and speeds behind for a boundary at long off. It seems that Kusal has injured himself in the process. Nothing serious though.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, du Plessis fails to flick it off his pads.

FOUR! Skipper is off the mark with a boundary. Too full in length on off, du Plessis punches it down the ground and it races past Malinga at mid on. Kusal Perera chases it from mid off, puts in a dive near the fence, pulls it back as well but the ball once again rolls back to touch the fence. To start with, the Lankan skipper should have put in a dive to stop the ball.
Full in length outside off, de Kock drives it down the ground and the mid off fielder moves across to his left to stop the ball. A single has been taken.
Kasun Rajitha is the first bowling change, replacing his skipper from this end.
This one is on and around off, the length is fuller than the last one, de Kock blocks it to the off side. End of a successful over, a wicket and a run from it.
On a length around middle and off, du Plessis defends it off his back foot.
Skipper Faf du Plessis is in next. Two slips in place.

OUT! Reeza Hendricks' poor run of form continues and with Aiden Markram scoring a truck-load of runs in domestic cricket, his spot is in serious danger. Udana, meanwhile, has taken his maiden ODI scalp. He angles across a length ball outside off and it appears that the ball stops a bit onto the batsman. Hendricks checks his drive at the last moment and chips it in the air towards mid off. A simple catch for Malinga and South Africa lose their first wicket.
Angling away from the batsman, a bit of extra bounce, Reeza controls his back foot punch and pushes it out towards cover-point.
Straighter in line, de Kock turns it in front of square leg and rotates the strike.
Full and on off, de Kock presses forward and blocks it with a straight bat.
A touch short this time, on middle, de Kock watchfully plays it down to square leg. The batsmen have run through for a single. 7 coming off this over.
A yorker on middle, de Kock digs it out carefully.

Taps a length ball to short mid-wicket and rushes across to the other end. Kamindu, the debutant, releases a throw at the bowler's end with his left hand, but fails to score a direct hit. In case you don't know, he's ambidextrous.
Full and on middle, de Kock eases it down to mid on. The fielder is at the edge of the circle and hence it's an easy run.
Malinga switches to over the wicket and bowls an inswinger on the leg stump line. De Kock tries to flick but misses and it goes off his thigh pad to the off side.

FOUR! Amazing shot from de Kock. Malinga angles in a back of a length delivery outside off, Quinton brings his wrists into play and punches it uppishly past his partner at the other end. The mid on fielder puts in a dive but fails to cut it off.
Ends the over with an identical delivery that he started the over with. Nice and straight, Reeza defends it off his back foot. Slow going from the Proteas in Powerplay 1.
A low full toss on off, de Kock drags it on the leg side off the inside half of his bat. It goes to the left of mid on and they cross for a run.
In the channel outside off, shaping away, de Kock covers the line and shoulders arms.
Pitches it up and around off, de Kock plays a cover drive but fails to beat the fielder inside the ring. Sri Lanka have pulled things back nicely after an expensive first over.
A leg stump half-volley this time, an off cutter, Reeza flicks it through square leg and there is a fielder in the deep. Only a run.
Nice and straight, angling across the right-hander, Hendricks plays it close to his body and pushes it out to the left of the bowler.

Angles in a shortish ball on off, de Kock hangs on the back foot and turns it on the leg side. Not much timing and this one rolls straight towards the fielder at mid on. A good comeback over from the Lankan skipper, only 2 from this one.
Identical to the last delivery, de Kock stays on the back foot and taps it down with soft hands towards the right of backward point.
A touch short and on off, angling in, de Kock blocks it solidly towards cover-point.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, de Kock is lured into a shot, tries playing the square cut but fails to connect.

Switches to over the wicket for the right-hander and serves a length ball on off. Hendricks pushes it with gentle hands to covers and rushes to the other end. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but it's a weak one and also way off target.
Malinga delivers a shortish ball outside off from 'round the wicket angle, de Kock rocks back and slaps it to deep point for one.
Shortish and on off, de Kock goes on his toes and guides it down to third man for a run. 3 coming from this over, a good one by Isuru.
Stays away from the batsman's hitting zone. Bowls it wide but just inside the tramline, de Kock shows patience and doesn't go after it.
Extra bounce once more for Udana. He drops it on a good length outside off, de Kock makes a leave and Dickwella collects the ball near his face.
Back of a length ball on off, shaping away, Reeza taps it down wide of the diving backward point fielder for a run. He is off the mark now.
Takes a length ball away from the right-hander with his angle. Reeza covers his stumps and allows it through to the keeper. A watchful approach by Hendricks here.
Some extra bounce on the first ball from Udana. It's outside off, Quinton controls it well and then runs it down to third man for a run.
Isuru Udana to bowl with the second new nut.
Closer to the off stump, on a length, Hendricks plays at it from the crease and pushes it to covers. 9 from the first over, a good start for the Proteas.
A nice away shape on this occasion. It's landing on a length and Hendricks shoulders arms.
On a length outside off, de Kock drives it in the gap at extra cover to rotate the strike.

FOUR! Lovely timing and placement! Good length delivery outside off, angling away from the southpaw, de Kock rocks back and steers it past the point fielder. Akila gives the chase but comes second best. South Africa off to a fine start.
Malinga eyes a yorker this time but it's a full toss outside off, de Kock hits it through the line but finds the cover fielder.

FOUR! Straightaway a shot from a batsman in prime form. Some inward movement for Malinga but the line is too straight. De Kock picks it off his pads and flicks it through the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary.

Right then, it's time to get going. The Sri Lankan players are spreading on the field. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks are the South African openers. All of a sudden, it has turned a bit overcast. The Lankan pacers would like to extract some movement with the two new balls. It's Lasith Malinga to speed in first up...
National anthems time. Both teams are lined up in the middle at the moment. Sri Lanka's first followed by South Africa's.

Toss - Sri Lanka win the coin-flip and Lasith Malinga has decided that they will FIELD FIRST. A couple of changes for them. They have handed a debut to Kamindu Mendis and he comes in place of Dhananjaya de Silva. Also, Isuru Udana gets a chance, replacing Vishwa Fernando. South Africa, too, have made two changes - Anrich Nortje and Wiaan Mulder make way for Tabraiz Shamsi and Dwaine Pretorius.

Weather report - Clear blue skies welcome us and the ground is bathed in bright sunshine at the moment. There is a forecast though for rain but it's later in the evening. Let's hope that they arrive after we are done with this match.

Welcome ladies and gentlemen for the third ODI between South Africa and Sri Lanka in Durban. The visitors have a 2-0 advantage after faring exceedingly well in the previous two ties and will be eyeing an unassailable lead today. For Sri Lanka, nothing has worked so far in this format but they are returning to a venue where they achieved a miraculous Test win over the hosts recently. With happy memories of Kingsmead, the Islanders would like to take inspiration and turn things around. Stay tuned for more updates...
